title: Revalidate delegation caller eligibility if session roles can change
outcome: The delegation MCP bridge caches caller eligibility for its lifetime. That is security-safe today because a session classified as a root by both parent_delegation_id and the durable delegation-child index is never converted into a child under the same id. Revisit the cache if either trigger occurs: (a) any feature allows root-to-child conversion, adoption, id reuse, or late attachment to a delegation (mandatory revalidation), or (b) the existing child-to-root adoption path needs peer tools without restarting the bridge (quality improvement). Evaluate TTL refresh versus an explicit immutable caller-role capability without restoring a full /api/state fetch per message.
acceptance: The bridge revalidates or receives an authoritative immutable role whenever root-to-child conversion becomes possible; child-to-root adoption can optionally refresh without restart; exact-id sustained messaging does not regress to a full-state fetch per call.
